# Who may appear as the author or committer of a commit in this repository,
# and who may be named in a Co-authored-by: trailer.
#
# scripts/attribution-guard.sh reads this file and fails the pull request on
# anything that is not listed. Widening it is a reviewed decision, taken in its
# own commit - never a step on the way to a green check.
#
# One entry per line:
#
#   ADDRESS             allowed as author and as committer
#   committer:ADDRESS   allowed as committer only
#   bot:LOGIN           allowed as the GitHub account behind a commit
#
# Three entries are built into the script and need no line here:
# committer:noreply@github.com (a merge made through the GitHub web UI), and
# the dependabot[bot], github-actions[bot] and renovate[bot] logins. That last
# one covers the cask push scripts/publish-cask.sh makes on release, which
# commits as 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com.

# The maintainer, under both addresses the history uses: the work address and
# the GitHub forwarding address a push from the web or a squash merge carries.
# scripts/release.sh commits the version bump as the first of the two.
fschmutz@premaccess.com
6752695+fschmutz@users.noreply.github.com

# Contributors whose commits are already in this repository's history. Listed
# so a new pull request from one of them is not red before anyone has read it;
# drop the line when the contribution is done.
giovanni.bthx@gmail.com
124669058+Giovannibthx@users.noreply.github.com
